intro: Achieve naturally fuller, healthier-looking eyebrows with Derma Radiant Eyebrow Growth Serum. Expertly formulated with nourishing ingredients, this lightweight serum helps condition eyebrow hairs, supports healthy growth, and improves the appearance of thin or sparse brows. Regular use helps strengthen each strand, reduce breakage, and promote a naturally thicker, well-defined look.

Its gentle, non-greasy formula absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky residue, making it ideal for everyday use. Whether your eyebrows have become thin due to over-plucking, makeup, or daily wear, this serum helps nourish the brow area while enhancing softness, shine, and overall brow health.
Suitable for both men and women, Derma Radiant Eyebrow Growth Serum is designed for all skin types and can be easily added to your daily beauty routine.

li: Improves the appearance of sparse brows
Suitable for all skin types and both men & women

p: Clean and dry the eyebrow area before application. Apply a small amount of serum evenly along the eyebrows using the applicator. Leave it on without rinsing. For best results, use once or twice daily as part of your skincare routine.
Net Quantity: 30 mlSuitable For: All Skin Types | Men & Women
